const services = [
  {
    id: "general-service",
    name: "General Service",
    description:
      "Complete multi-point checkup covering engine tuning, chain lubrication, brake and clutch adjustment, and a full safety inspection.",
    price: 499,
    image:
      "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1558981806-ec527fa84c39?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80",
  },
  {
    id: "oil-change",
    name: "Oil Change",
    description:
      "Engine oil and filter replacement using premium grade oil to keep your engine running smooth and extend its life.",
    price: 349,
    image:
      "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1635784063504-52b96c0a3078?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80",
  },
  {
    id: "brake-service",
    name: "Brake Service",
    description:
      "Brake pad inspection and replacement, disc cleaning, and fluid top-up for confident, reliable stopping power.",
    price: 299,
    image:
      "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1615172282427-9a57ef2d142e?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80",
  },
  {
    id: "water-wash",
    name: "Water Wash",
    description:
      "Thorough exterior wash, degreasing, and polish to keep your bike looking as good as it rides.",
    price: 149,
    image:
      "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1571068316344-75bc76f77890?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80",
  },
];

export default services;
